_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/logic-grid/store/screenshots.json apps/logic-grid/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from app-verify (apps/logic-grid/qa) and are copied into store/raw. Ordered by beauty, not by tab order — but the line comes second rather than last, per the spec's 4.3 note that the listing must not open on a bare grid. The background is the zinc slab going to copper; the font is the app's own New York.
